body:
This is due to this code: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/master/extensions/resteasy-server-common/deployment/src/main/java/io/quarkus/resteasy/server/common/deployment/ResteasyServerCommonProcessor.java#L491 .

We have several options:
- live with it: I don't think that's acceptable as it's going to log an exception in A LOT of cases
- remove it: not sure it's a good idea as it would break some Jackson install
- it's logged by a `printStackTrace()` that was previously commented. If allowing an incomplete classpath solves the issue; maybe we could revert this change for this version and add it again once we allow the incomplete classpath. We would need to check it fixes the issue though as I suppose we want this stacktrace in some cases.
- move that to Jackson extensions. But I don't think we have the time to do that before tomorrow and Jackson is split in a lot of modules so I don't know how many extensions we would need to do that properly. If we just take these two classes, it's already two separate extensions jaxb and databind.

@dmlloyd what do you think about commenting the stacktrace again for tomorrow's release? We would have more time to think about a proper fix for the next release.

> @dmlloyd what do you think about commenting the stacktrace again for tomorrow's release? We would have more time to think about a proper fix for the next release.

Sure, seems fine, as long as it's tracked & fixed later.

> > @dmlloyd what do you think about commenting the stacktrace again for tomorrow's release? We would have more time to think about a proper fix for the next release.
> 
> Sure, seems fine, as long as it's tracked & fixed later.

Maybe comment for tomorrow release with reference to this issue and keep this issue open for tracking?

I think I will just test if the classes are in the classpath for now.

This way, the workaround is very localized and where the things are already a bit ad hoc.

We do that a few lines above for another class.

I'll try to push something this evening.
